Werewolf.title: The Werewolves of Millers Hollow
Werewolf.boxAlt: Box of The Werewolves of Millers Hollow card game

rules.title: One night, one day, one vote.

setup.title: Setup
setup.text: A narrator, who doesn't play, deals one random card to each player. Everyone secretly discovers their identity: villager or werewolf.

night.title: Night
night.text: Everyone closes their eyes. The werewolves wake up and silently point at their victim together. Special roles then use their powers.

day.title: Day
day.text: The village wakes up and the narrator reveals the victims. Debate: villagers hunt for the wolves, who try to deflect suspicion.

vote.title: Vote
vote.text: Everyone points at a suspect. The player chosen by the majority is eliminated and their identity revealed. Night falls again.

mayor.title: The mayor
mayor.text: Elected on the first day — even a wolf can run. Their vote counts twice. When eliminated, they name a successor with their last breath.

end.title: End of the game
end.text: The game ends when only villagers… or only werewolves remain.

roles.title: Who are you tonight?
roles.more: … and many more roles in the box: Actor, Lawyer, Executioner, Shaman, Time Master, Magician, Ghost, Revenant, Joker…

villager.name: Villager
villager.text: No power: uses their voice and vote during the day to eliminate the werewolves.

seer.name: Seer
seer.text: Every night, she secretly discovers one player's identity.

witch.name: Witch
witch.text: Two potions — one to heal, one to poison — each usable only once.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.text: Every night, he protects one player from the werewolves' attack.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.text: When he dies, he immediately eliminates a player of his choice.

cupid.name: Cupid
cupid.text: On the first night, he names two lovers bound together until the end of the game.

littleGirl.name: Little Girl
littleGirl.text: She can peek during the night to unmask the wolves.

knight.name: Knight
knight.text: His armour protects him from the werewolves' first attack.

fox.name: Fox
fox.text: He points at three neighbours: the narrator tells him whether a wolf is among them.

detective.name: Detective
detective.text: Once per round, he learns whether two players are on the same team.

raven.name: Raven
raven.text: He names a player who will start the next vote with two votes against them.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.text: Every night, the wolves wake up to eliminate a villager.

alphaWolf.name: Alpha Werewolf
alphaWolf.text: Once per game, he can infect the victim and turn them into a wolf.

blueWolf.name: Blue Wolf
blueWolf.text: He fools the Seer, who sees him as a simple villager.

redWolf.name: Red Werewolf
redWolf.text: Before the attack, he learns whether a player is a simple villager or a VIP role.

mysticWolf.name: Mystic Werewolf
mysticWolf.text: He takes the card of a wolves' victim and gains its powers.

whiteWolf.name: White Werewolf
whiteWolf.text: He hunts with the pack… but his goal is to be the last one standing.

piper.name: Pied Piper
piper.text: Everyone's enemy, he charms two new players every night.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.text: Everyone's enemy, he bites a player at the start of every night.

serialKiller.name: Serial Killer
serialKiller.text: Every other night, he can kill the person of his choice.
